preview: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots face Barbados Tridents in CPL 2026 Match 23 at Warner Park. The match is scheduled for Tue 1 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
